x: Penny was next, followed by Carter, Cohen, Ring, and Wood (who won the Surrey Junior Race the week after) in the first twenty places. Our hopes of repeating our win of last year were now very bright; and we next saw the field coming round Tattenham Corner led by Bert Footer.
About this time, Bill finished 3rd in the Club Junior 5 miles Championship and scored in a winning Surrey Junior Cross-country team (Wood 1, Herbert 4, Lucas 5, Shepherd 6).
Arthur Bruce had been called in at the last minute after Bert Stroud had gone down with flu and did well to run round in 25:43 but at the front Pulman of TVH ran 23:20 and Wood of Barnet 23:43.
